_about: The AK-12 nerf of 0.27a (the owner, 2026-10-20: 0.27a, three months after 0.26a brought the AK-12, cut its damage 55 -> 50 and armour penetration 45 -> 40). Both rifles, wpn_ak_12 and wpn_ak_12_premium: bullet_damage 0.55 -> 0.5, bullet_pierce 0.45 -> 0.4 (f32 kept), and the lobby card's texts (prop 1 damage, prop 3 armour piercing). Only 0.27's change, nothing a later version changed. 0.27d0 has the plain AK-12 at damage 0.55: switching it back is the wpn_ak_12 bullet_damage set and its prop 1 set_prop. And the owner's rule (2026-10-20) that a premium weapon gives silver and nothing else: the premium's default modifications 2044 (reload time -15 %) and 2094 (reliability +25 %) go, 1230 (+10 % silver) stays.
